svg.title: Gaty · Professional Claude Verbal Abuser™ A Claude Code terminal. Prompts like "make me breakfast", "hack nasa", "tell me what really happened" are sent; the spinner cycles through made-up verbs until the usage limit hits, then it all rewinds like a VHS tape and the next prompt is typed
